main_text.l: Amplissima hic quidem dicendi seges exoritur; sed
plurima paucis complecti libet. vester Cl. Espencæus a-
cerbè admodùm inuehitur in aliquot Rom. Ecclesiæ E-
piscopos, iam, post Conc. Tridentini reformationem scili-
cet: ab ipso Authore causam addiscamus. {k}Quotusquisq;

l.i: docere videtur? an illi ipsi decreti huius (nempe in Con-
cilio Tridentino) Authores unquàm docuerunt, quo-
rum exemplo aly ad munera sua facienda excitarentur?

main_text.l: Certè ex nostratibus Episcopis, qui Tridenti, & Bononiæ
pars aliquota fuerunt, nemo per se (quod quidem audive-
rim) docet. Ludimusne in re adeo seria? an potius hæc
Decretorum specie reformationem posterioribus illudimus? Hæc
Espencæus. Addit, nouisse se quosdam Episcopos, qui ut

l.i: se adiistam docendis seruitutem demittant (generosi & excell-
enti viri!) teneri præstare negent: Quos (ait) cùm omnis omni-
um temporum historia Ecclesia, Concilia, Pontifices, Cesares,
Superi, inferi, accusent, damnentq;, quis est qui absoluat?

page.notes: Long s is printed like f throughout and is transcribed as s. Doubtful readings: "quonis" (possibly quovis), "mecumq;" (the letters are unclear), "Digress 2 2." in the note k, which may be read differently, and "lib.f." in the note *. The italic and roman split of the quotations from Espencæus is approximate. The mark for the note p is not clearly visible in the text. The last word "est," stands alone below the last line and is given as the catchword. The printed page number is 92, and the running head reads "De Authoritate, & Dignitate" with "Cap.2." as printed. The watermark "Digitized by Google" is excluded.
